==Walkthrough==
{{Map|2561,3221|r=4|mtype=square|width=220|height=220|align=right|caption=The stone circle's location.}}
{{Checklist|''Players may wish to grab a jug of water from the cooking shop in Yanille if they do not have one to avoid a trip to Al Kharid.''
*Talk to [[Brother Omad]] at the [[Ardougne Monastery|Monastery]] south of [[Ardougne]]. {{Chat option|1 Why can't you sleep, what's wrong?|1 Yes}}
*Go west of the monastery, slightly south-west of the [[Clock Tower (building)|Clock Tower]], to a perfect stone circle, enter it and go down the ladder in the middle.
*Follow the first path south and pick up the [[Child's blanket]].
*Return to Brother Omad and talk to him twice. {{Chat option|1 Who's Brother Cedric?|2 Where should I look?}}
*Go north and talk to [[Brother Cedric]], who is directly south of the [[Ardougne Zoo]], near the well.
*Talk to him again to give him a [[jug of water]]. {{Chat option|2 Yes, I'd be happy to!}}
*Speak to him again and give him the [[logs]] or [[plank]].
*Return to Brother Omad.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
